messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] killing branches
parts:
On May 17, 2014, at 7:12 PM, Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:

> - feature/mixed_type

...
> The mixed_type stuff I guess we are never going to be able to implement.

I think we'd need to get someone to take it on as a major
project in conjunction with the Eigen developers. It'd be
a major change to Eigen, which doesn't currently allow mixed types
other than in their totally hacked-together complex support.

And I'm not sure that breaking things out that
way would even be the best way to implement matrix ops for us.

What would be great is to be able to take advantage of more of
the expression templates. Michael was getting a huge speedup in
his new auto-diff by passing more general expression template types
which don't require a copy-to-Matrix.

- Bob
